prompts.logo: Edit target: the supplied Yuri & Geovanna monogram. Preserve EXACT arrangement and spelling: interlocked stacked Y and G, finely detailed fern along the left, elegant double circular border, text 'Yuri & Geovanna' and '13 . 01 . 2027' on right. Create a polished three dimensional raised embossed olive green monogram, like sculpted fine stationery with subtle lit bevel edges and delicate natural dimensional shadows, not metallic chrome. Crisp rich forest olive, living fresh green, very refined and readable at website sizes. Crucial: remove the entire off-white background; true transparent alpha PNG, including inside the circle and between the fern and letter details. All glyph shapes and elements float isolated on transparency. No paper sheet, no square backing, no extra flowers, no distress or sepia, no changes to text. Fill canvas with original emblem plus modest 7% clear margins. Premium wedding visual identity, restrained realistic relief.
prompts.floral: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: luxury botanical wedding website corner decoration, transparent alpha background. A generous airy organic L-shaped arrangement rooted in the bottom-left corner, sweeping up the left edge and along the bottom. Fresh ivory white lilies with subtle natural green centers, a few soft white garden roses and white lisianthus, delicate fern fronds and eucalyptus, living sage and deep olive greens. Beautiful refined botanical watercolor with softly realistic dimensional petals, delicate detailed leaves, fine-art stationery quality, happy luminous spring feeling, no sepia. Composition leaves the upper-right 65% EMPTY TRANSPARENT for typography. Flowers large and legible, lush but airy, no enclosing rectangular background, no text, no vase, no people, no badges. True isolated PNG with transparency between stems and petals. A coherent floral arrangement, not scattered clip art.
